FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of

FA and CAO, Eastern Railway, Kolkata A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions of the contrac t 1. Minimum 2 drivers shall be provided to cover 24 hrs. duty. Weekly rest etc. shall be arranged by provi ding suitable reliever. 2. Sundays / Holidays will also be treated as Normal working day for payment. It will be the contractor’s r esponsibility to maintain the Log book of the vehicle on daily basis. 3. Taxes and duties: Road tax and insurance in respect of vehicle, the document of the Vehicle like taxi p ermit, road tax, insurance, driver license etc. are to kept updated during the contract period and shall s ubmit attested photocopies of the above to this office. 4. The vehicle shall be kept cleaned, washed and in excellent running condition. In case vehicle is under breakdown, the party will arrange replacement with another vehicle, which is in perfect working order a nd not older than three years. 5. Maintenance: The party will ensure running / major maintenance of the vehicle in order to keep it in pe rfect working condition at their own cost and risk. 6. All the statutory rules and regulations required for running of the vehicle under the contract shall be fol lowed by the contractor at no extra cost. Any fines, penalties imposed by such statutory authorities will be borne by the contractor at his own risk and cost. 7. The bidder shall submit the details of the vehicle proposed to be deployed, including registration numb er, make/model and year of manufacture, along with copies of the Registration Certificate (RC), valid in surance, fitness certificate, applicable permit and Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate, wherever ap plicable, along with the bid. The Railway reserves the right to verify the authenticity and validity of the d ocuments submitted. 8. The contractor must be the owner of the vehicle or a power of attorney holder of the vehicle from the o wner of the vehicle or holder of authorization to run the vehicle under contract period. 9. The vehicle should be available to the Railway, with Driver, fuel, engine oil etc. for 24 hours on all days of week irrespective of holidays. Adequate quantity of fuel shall be maintained in tank of the vehicle, so that vehicle can be mobilized for long distances in case of emergencies without waiting for fuel filling. 10. Drivers shall be required to present before CC/HWH to intimate his presence on taking charge whenev er change driver/shift of driver takes place. Any other periodicity of recording driver’s attendance may a lso be imposed during execution of contract as per requirement the same shall be followed. 11. The vehicle could be stationed at any place as per direction of the Railway Administration. 12. No accommodation and garage facility will be provided by the Railway to the driver and for the vehicle, contractor has to make his own arrangements for these facilities. 13. Driver of the vehicle should be having a mobile number to be made available to the Railway Administr ation. Mobile Phone has to be provided to the driver at contractor’s cost during the whole period of cont ract with outgoing facility. 14. The contractor shall be completely responsible for safe running of the vehicle. The Railways will not be responsible for any loss, damage, repairs, maintenance or accident to the vehicle or driver. 15. Driver of the vehicle shall maintain a log book indicating the following particulars therein (a) Date, (b) t ime, (c) Km (d) name of the Railway Official using the vehicle (e) Signature of the Railway Officials (f) Remarks. 16. The seats of the vehicle should have good and clean cloth covers, which must be changed regularly. T he cleanliness and fresh ambience shall be ensured inside vehicle by providing regular cleaning and fre shener etc.

17. Driver employed should be in proper uniform. They also to be provided with identity card and same ma y be produced on demand during checking. The contractor, at his own cost, shall supply uniforms to all employees along with ebonite or metal badges displaying their name, designation, Aadhar number, ESI C, and PF numbers. 18. The driver shall remain contactable during duty hours and maintain proper coordination with the desig nated Crew Management official. The driver shall strictly comply with authorised instructions regarding reporting time, pickup and drop-off locations and movement of Railway personnel.
